name: PaybyMe for WooCommerce
author: PaybyMe

sections.description:
PaybyMe Payment Gateway for WooCommerce allows you to accept payment on your WooCommerce store via PaybyMe as it provides a safe and fast payment experience for your customers.

Key Features

  • Secure payment flow via PaybyMe VPOS
  • Installment configuration per product
  • Refund support via WooCommerce interface
  • Detailed logging for payments and refunds

A brief Markdown Example

You can enable logging, test mode, and customize return URLs. To learn more, visit PaybyMe or contact your integration support team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/paybyme-woocommerce directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable “PaybyMe”.
  4. Enter your PaybyMe API credentials and configure the options, such as allowed IPs and redirect URLs.
sections.faq:
Which payment methods can I use with PaybyMe?

You can accept credit/debit card payments via PaybyMe.

Does it support installments?

Yes. You can enable or disable installment support per product using a custom checkbox on the product edit screen.

Are refunds supported?

Yes. You can initiate refunds directly from the WooCommerce order edit screen.
